sample.question:
You may add exactly one mirror to an empty cell. Which option makes the laser hit a target instead of its original terminal result?
Options:
[1] place / at (1, 3)
[2] place \ at (5, 1)
[3] place / at (1, 2)
[4] place \ at (1, 4)
[5] place \ at (1, 7)
[6] place / at (1, 1)
sample.analysis:
Testing option 2, adding \ at (5, 1) changes the path as follows:
Cell (4, 1): empty.
Cell (4, 2): empty.
Cell (4, 3): mirror \ turns right to down.
Cell (5, 3): empty.
Cell (6, 3): empty.
Cell (7, 3): hit target C.
The beam reaches target C, so choose option 2.

state_content.rules: A laser starts outside the grid and travels cell by cell. '/' and '\' mirrors reflect it; stone blocks absorb it; targets are hit when the beam enters their cell.
